errors.evidence: This error occurs for all five lines. The description states the lines start at N=0, but the plot shows the first data points for all lines are at a positive N-value (approximately N=1 or N=2), not on the y-axis itself.
The blue line starts at an AUC value of approximately 94%, not 95%.
The blue line decreases to a value of approximately 94% at N=20, not 96%.
The orange line starts at an AUC of approximately 83.5%, not 87%.
The orange line shows a slight decrease from N=15 (approx. 95%) to N=20 (approx. 94.5%). Describing this as remaining steady is an over-generalization.
The green line does not rise to this point; it falls after peaking at N=15 (approx. 94.5%) to a value of approximately 92% at N=20. Both the trend ('rises') and the value ('94%') are incorrect.
The red line starts at an AUC of approximately 87%, not 90%.
The red line increases to a peak value of approximately 98.5% at N=10, not 96%.
The purple line drops to a value of approximately 82% at N=20, not 84%.
